newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends higher vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends higher vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly firmer against the dollar and steady against the central bank's currency basket, traders said on Thursday.
The forint finished at 184.50/55 against the dollar compared with an opening of 184.65/70 but below the day's peak of 184.15/20, after the dollar recovered from a seven-month low against the yen.
Traders said the forint remained pinned to the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level throughout the day.
(NBH basket: 30 percent dollar, 70 percent German mark.)
